question: Where can I get the current electricity network access tariffs and charges in Spain, by voltage level and period, with their history?

answer.summary: Peajes (network access tariffs) are set yearly by CNMC resolution and cargos (system charges) by MITERD order, both in BOE, with 2.0TD to 6.4TD by period P1-P6. Current 2026 values: MITECO peajes page (both) and BOE-A-2025-26348 (peajes), BOE-A-2025-26705 (cargos). History since 2021-06 is the chain of BOE resolutions/orders; 2014-2021 frozen old-structure orders. No CSV/API of the series was found.
main_caveats: Peajes (CNMC, networks) and cargos (Ministry, other system costs) are separate documents; a full regulated price needs both. Do not add transport and distribution parts on top of the T&D line.
No official CSV, API or time series exists in what was found: values sit in BOE text tables and an HTML page. History needs one BOE document per year; BOE legal status flags do not show supersession.
MITECO page shows 2,051434 for cargos segment 3 power P3-P5; the BOE order text says 2,054134. Take the BOE as the legal text.

Periods P1-P6 depend on season, day type and territory (Peninsula, Balearics, Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla); 2.0TD has 3 energy periods and 2 power periods. Hours are in Circular 3/2020 art. 7, not in the price resolutions.
2025 has two peajes documents: Res. 4-12-2024 (from 2025-01-01) and Res. 6-3-2025 replacing only Annex II (excess power) from 2025-04-01. Cargos 2024 order was published 2024-02-14.
answer.confidence_reason: Official BOE texts and CNMC files opened and values cross-checked (BOE, MITECO page, CNMC Excel and memoria agree except one cell); older years read from the BOE text.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL "https://www.boe.es/diario_boe/xml.php?id=BOE-A-2025-26348" -o res2026.xml ; then strip tags, find ANEXO I, 1. Precios ... a) Términos de potencia contratada. For other years the same URL with the BOE id above; to find an id: curl -sL -H "Accept: application/xml" "https://www.boe.es/datosabiertos/api/boe/sumario/20241216" and look for the item title 'valores de los peajes de acceso'.
steps: Pick the year; the file is the resolution published in December of the previous year (see members). For 2021 take the 18-03-2021 resolution (applies from 2021-06-01).

Download the BOE XML, remove tags, and locate ANEXO I. Each of power and energy has three consecutive tables: transport, distribution, transport and distribution. Use the last for what a customer pays.
Rows are 2.0 TD, 3.0 TD, 6.1 TD, 6.2 TD, 6.3 TD, 6.4 TD; flattened text leaves blanks, so 2.0 TD has only 2 power values and 3 energy values, and others have 6.
For EV points use Annex I section 3 (3.0 TDVE, 6.1 TDVE, 6.2 TDVE). Annex II has excess-power prices and Annex III reactive-energy prices.
For 2025 take Annex I from the 2024-12-04 resolution and Annex II from the 2025-03-06 resolution.
Cargos are in source 2; add them by segment (2.0TD = segment 1, 3.0TD = 2, 6.1TD = 3, 6.2TD = 4, 6.3TD = 5, 6.4TD = 6).
reading_traps: BOE metadata marks all old resolutions estatus_derogacion=N (not repealed); each is superseded by the next, so use the applicability date.
In the 2026 text the 6.1 TDVE and 6.2 TDVE power table header reads 'Periodo 1 Periodo 2 Periodo 1 Periodo 4 Periodo 1 Periodo 6' (typo); the six values are P1 to P6.
6.4 TD has no distribution part (all zeros in the CNMC Excel); its peaje is the transport part only.
Period hours are not in these resolutions; see source 5. A 2021 first-year price applies only 2021-06-01 to 2021-12-31.
Prices have six decimals; do not round before multiplying by contracted power.

Tables are flattened in the XML and need care when parsing.

steps: Use IET/107/2014 Annex I for every peaje except 6.1A and 6.1B; use IET/2444/2014 Annex I for 6.1A and 6.1B.
For 2019 follow Orden TEC/1366/2018 article 2, for 2020 Orden TEC/1258/2019, for 2021-01 to 2021-05 Orden TED/1271/2020: all keep those prices.
From 2021-06-01 use sources 1 and 2.
reading_traps: The old peajes contain what are now cargos; do not compare directly with TD peajes.
6.1A is set by the 2015 order, the other peajes by the 2014 order.
Orden TEC/1258/2019 text was not opened; only its title was seen.

regulator.name: Comision Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC) sets peajes; Ministerio para la Transicion Ecologica y el Reto Demografico (MITERD) sets cargos

operators.note: Red Electrica (transport) plus many distributors (i-DE, e-distribucion, UFD, etc. and small ones); they apply the same national prices, they do not set them. Iberdrola document on peajes returned 403 to automated clients.

publication_obligation.norm: Circular 3/2020 art. 13 and Ley 3/2013 art. 7.1 bis (CNMC publishes values in BOE each year); Real Decreto 148/2021 art. 7 (cargos by ministerial order)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Annual resolution with peajes prices by group and period; annual order with cargos prices by segment and period

consolidated_republication.note: MITECO republishes only the current year; CNMC keeps an expediente per year but no consolidated series. BOE is the only place with every year.

checked_pages.saw: Current 2026 peajes (CNMC resolution) and cargos (Orden TED/1524/2025) tables by period, plus segment-to-peaje mapping; no history.
Expediente with resolution, memoria, Excel allocation model and BOE copy for peajes 2026.
Page lists only recent expedientes; no historical archive of peajes resolutions.
PVPC page lists regulations for peajes and cargos but no amounts.

national_registry.note: The BOE is the official single register of the prices (annual CNMC resolution and MITERD order). It is not a dataset: each year is a separate document.

checked_pages.saw: Resolution CNMC 18-12-2025 with Annex I prices and list of previous annual resolutions since 2021.

recipe: Download xml.php?id=<id> for each, strip tags and cut text from 'ANEXO I' (peajes) or from 'Primero' (cargos) to the next annex.
In peajes Annex I take the third table of each term (T&D) and read rows by group: tested on BOE-A-2025-26348 (2.0 TD 23,324952 0,443770 EUR/kW year).
Build one table per year with group, period, term, unit and the applicability date; keep the March 2025 Annex II replacement as a separate row set from 2025-04-01.
For years before 2021-06 use source 6 Annex I tables (tested on IET/107/2014: 2.0A 38,043426 EUR/kW year).
if_unstructured.location_method: Not applicable: prices are national, by tariff group and period; territory only affects the period hours (Circular 3/2020 art. 7).
cross_with: Circular 3/2020 art. 7 for hours of each period
Contracted power and voltage level on the supply contract (CUPS) to pick the tariff group

where_published.name: Boletin Oficial del Estado (annual CNMC resolution and MITERD order)
where_published.what: Official text with price tables for each year
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE search by title 'valores de los peajes de acceso a las redes de transporte y distribucion' (CNMC) or 'precios de los cargos del sistema electrico' (Ministry); or use the BOE sumario API by date: curl -sL -H "Accept: application/xml" https://www.boe.es/datosabiertos/api/boe/sumario/AAAAMMDD and filter item titles. Dates return 404 on days without a BOE.
